units: <cite ref="Menachot 40b:9">Men. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>היא של ב׳ וכ׳</he> if (the garment) itself is a web, but its borders are of leather.
<cite ref="Menachot 40b:9">Ib.</cite> the principal element <he>ב׳ בעינן</he> must be a web (in order to require Tsitsith). Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin 3, v. <cite ref="B00073">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:12">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ב׳ א״הר</he> Adam’s garments, v. <cite ref="A00842"><he>אוֹר</he> II</cite>, 3.

<cite ref="Yoma 60b:2">Yoma 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ לבן</he> the Highpriest’s white garments (for the Day of Atone, <cite ref="Leviticus 16:4">Lev. XVI, 4</cite>), contrad. to <he>ב׳ זהב</he> gold-embroidered &c. Ib. 68ᵇ; a. fr.
